fullDescription: A high-end, futuristic dark-mode chat interface featuring a glassmorphism aesthetic. It utilizes a striking contrast between deep charcoal backgrounds (#0e0e0e) and vibrant lime accents (#bef264). Characterized by premium editorial typography (Cabinet Grotesk Italic), gradient-based lighting effects, and soft-blur floating background orbs. This design system is ideal for creative platforms, spatial computing interfaces, high-tech fintech apps, or premium community messaging dashboards.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dark-themed messaging system with a focus on depth and luminosity. It combines a semi-transparent glassmorphic sidebar and header with a spacious chat arena, utilizing bold italic typography and specific lime-green highlights for user presence. The interface features a unique dual-gradient background with floating elements to provide environmental atmosphere.

style.description: The style is 'Cyber-Premium' Glassmorphism. Typography pairings: 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Black/Italic) for headings and brand elements, and 'Satoshi' for functional UI and body text. Color scheme: Deep Black (#0e0e0e), Purple-to-Pink gradient (#6a48f2 to #d946ef), and Electric Lime (#bef264). The theme relies on thin 1px white/5% borders and heavy backdrop blurs (20px).
style.prompt: Create a design system with a base background of #0e0e0e. Use a primary accent gradient of linear-gradient(135deg, #6a48f2 0%, #d946ef 100%). Typography must feature 'Cabinet Grotesk' for titles (Font-weight: 800, Font-style: italic) and 'Satoshi' for body (Font-weights: 400, 500, 700). Glassmorphic elements should have background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(20px), and border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). Implement floating background orbs using large blurred divs (#6a48f2 and #d946ef) with a 15s ease-in-out 'float' animation. Buttons should use high-elevation shadows: shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgba(106,72,242,0.3)].

layout_and_structure.description: A three-tier layout: a sticky global header, a fixed left sidebar for utility and member lists, and a primary message feed with a bottom-aligned input system.

prompts.prompt: Height: 64px. Background: Glassmorphic panel with 1px bottom border (white/5%). Content: Left-aligned title in Cabinet Grotesk (Italic, Black) with a small secondary uppercase sub-tag. Right-aligned stacked avatar group with -8px overlap and white/10 borders.

Width: 320px. Border-right: 1px white/5%. Includes two sections: 'Notifications' and 'Online Members'. Notifications use an inner card (rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)) and a dashed-border 'add' button. Online members list uses 40px circular avatars with status indicator dots (Emerald-500 for online).

Spacing: 32px vertical gaps between messages. 'Other' messages: Left-aligned, gray background (rgba(255,255,255,0.06)), border-radius: 4px 20px 20px 20px. 'Mine' messages: Right-aligned, solid Lime (#bef264), dark text (#1a2e05), border-radius: 20px 4px 20px 20px, with an outer glow shadow matching the lime color at 20% opacity.

Bottom-docked. Contains a 128px height textarea with bg: white/5%, 16px border-radius. Send button: Full gradient background (#6a48f2 to #d946ef), 48px height, italic uppercase font, positioned on the right below the textarea.

special_ui_components.description: Distinctive high-contrast chat bubble for the primary user.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background: #bef264; Color: #1a2e05; border-radius: 20px 4px 20px 20px; font-weight: 500; shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(190, 242, 100, 0.2). Micro-interaction: Scale 1.02 on hover.
Large circular divs (500px-600px width); Filter: blur(100px); Opacity: 0.3 to 0.6; Animation: translateY(-40px) scale(1.1) over 15 seconds; Position: Fixed, z-index -1.

Background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6a48f2, #d946ef); Text: White, Cabinet Grotesk, Black weight, Italic; Padding: 16px 48px; Border-radius: 16px; Hover: translate-y(-4px) with increased shadow intensity.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain the specific asymmetric border-radii for message bubbles (one corner always sharper at 4px). MUST: Use Cabinet Grotesk ONLY for headers and buttons to maintain editorial feel. MUST NOT: Use solid black #000; use #0e0e0e for depth. MUST NOT: Use standard scrollbars; use custom-styled thin tracks with white/10 thumb color.
